description:
Repository configuration and the fixed-ref primitive are accepted together as a narrow, disjoint authority contract.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Acceptance verifies ruleset enforcement, App scope, protected environment separation, immutable-release state, read-only defaults, and the primitive's constant-ref and exact-readback behavior against the runbook.
- [hard] REQ-02: Adversarial acceptance proves other actors and credential types cannot create, update, delete, or cross-use candidate/final refs and that no credential survives the operation.
- [hard] REQ-03: The recorded handoff documents the stable primitive interface consumed by release workflows and confirms that this work creates no execution workflow, tag, release, or candidate byte.

## Notes

Blast radius: release-authority acceptance fixtures and evidence only.
title: Verify release authority isolation and acceptance
